summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release dated 20 August 2026 confirming the NOK equivalent of its previously announced first-quarter 2026 cash dividend. The USD 0.39 per-share dividend, declared 6 May 2026, converts to NOK 3.6882 based on Norges Bank's average USDNOK fixing rate of 9.4568 over seven business days centered on the 14 August 2026 record date. Payment occurs 27 August 2026 to Oslo Børs shareholders and New York Stock Exchange ADR holders. This is a routine dividend currency-fixing disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation apply.
